comments: The colophon names "brTson 'grus seng ge" as the scribe, but as this name is also given in the other instance of the work (ID:5152), we take it to be the scribe of the first copy of the work (ID:6843), from which this instance was directly or indirectly copied.
name: byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i 'grel pa gzhung don snang ba (3)
